races.paceDynamic: Bye Bye Now will lead uncontested with only light pressure from prominent runners An Laochmor, Snowballs, Jordan Breeze and Queen Of Newark sitting behind. This creates a moderate tempo that favors both the lone leader and strong-finishing hold-up horses who can unleash late kicks. The lack of pace pressure means Bye Bye Now can dictate terms while closers like Phil's Dream, Jazzit and potentially Sceitimini get perfect setup conditions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Bye Bye Now gets soft fractions and maintains stamina over 5f
scenarios.body: The leader controls from flag-fall without serious challenge until final furlong where recent good form and tactical advantage prove decisive. Prominent runners fail to apply enough pressure early, leaving insufficient time to reel in the pacesetter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows hold-up horses perfect launching pad for sustained finish
scenarios.body: Phil's Dream or Jazzit time their runs perfectly as the pace quickens approaching final two furlongs. Superior finishing kick from off the tempo overwhelms tiring pace-setters in final 100 yards.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If An Laochmor or Jordan Breeze position ideally and avoid their fading tendencies
scenarios.body: A prominent runner maintains striking position throughout before launching decisive challenge entering final furlong. Good recent form and tactical positioning overcome higher-rated but poorly-positioned rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Sceitimini overcomes recent poor form with perfectly-timed late surge
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in final quarter-mile allowing a hold-up horse with higher rating to unleash devastating late run. Class tells despite recent disappointing efforts when race dynamics suit perfectly.

watchPoints.text: Bye Bye Now breaking cleanly to secure uncontested lead as any early pressure could compromise stamina reserves
Phil's Dream and Jazzit positioning in rear third to maximize late running advantage as prominent placement would negate style
Jordan Breeze and An Laochmor sustaining effort in final furlong given both show concerning fade patterns recently
Sceitimini's early positioning as hold-up style needs cover and clear running room despite higher official rating

races.paceDynamic: Mc Loven stands alone as the natural leader but lacks the class to dictate strongly, creating a moderate early gallop. Beauty Queen, Dontspoilasale, I Bid You Ajou, I'm Spartacus and Edmond Halley will all vie for prominent positions behind, creating inevitable traffic problems when the field bunches turning for home over this straight 6f course.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Mc Loven gets an easy lead with the prominent pack settling further back than usual
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the hold-up horses to make up ground, allowing the leader to kick clear. Beauty Queen and I'm Spartacus emerge best from the chasing pack but cannot reel in the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners bunch up and create interference 2f out
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get clear runs down the outside while the prominent brigade gets tangled up. Collective Power and Sporting Hero capitalize on their patient tactics with late charges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Beauty Queen and I'm Spartacus press Mc Loven early and engage in a speed duel
scenarios.body: The pace quickens significantly, setting up perfectly for the better-class hold-up horses to strike late. Inishfallen and Clonmacash time their challenges to perfection in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Edmond Halley Fade Impact
scenarios.trigger: If Edmond Halley shows early pace but stops dramatically as usual
scenarios.body: His characteristic fade creates a gap that allows one of the mid-pack horses to thread through. I Bid You Ajou or Sporting Hero benefit from the opening to claim victory.

watchPoints.text: Edmond Halley typically shows early pace before stopping - his fade could cause interference or create gaps

Mc Loven's ability to sustain his early lead depends entirely on how hard the prominent pack presses him

races.paceDynamic: Love Bomb will take the field along as the only confirmed front runner, with Royal County Glory and Stone Bear likely to press from prominent positions. This should create a sustainable early gallop rather than breakneck speed, setting up the race perfectly for the large contingent of hold-up horses to mount late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Love Bomb sets an even tempo without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows the strong hold-up contingent to get into contention turning for home. Faustyna and Jampa Ling benefit most from their superior ratings in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Royal County Glory and Stone Bear apply early pressure to Love Bomb
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and prevents the hold-up horses from closing effectively. Stone Bear's recent Dundalk win and Royal County Glory's consistent prominent running pay dividends.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Love Bomb gets pressured hard early by multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: The front runners tie up badly in the final furlong after an unsustainable gallop. The best hold-up horses with proven stamina reserves come through late to capitalize.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Love Bomb gets an uncontested lead and finds better finishing kick than usual
scenarios.body: Love Bomb avoids her typical late fade by controlling the tempo completely from the front. Lady Landhort's recent win shows the outsiders can capitalize when conditions suit.

races.paceDynamic: Mehmar looks the most likely early leader with his prominent style, though several other prominent runners (Comfort Line, Alex Belardo, Punk Poet, Master Garvey) could press forward creating a moderate to strong gallop. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Palazzo Persico, Kitty Bear, Star Mind, Alto Sax, Deep Vein, Hi George) will look to benefit from any pace pressure, setting up a race where the tempo could quicken significantly in the final three furlongs as the field compacts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Strong Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners engage early and maintain pressure throughout
scenarios.body: The pace-setters burn each other out as Mehmar, Comfort Line, Alex Belardo and Punk Poet all commit forward. This opens the door for the strongest staying hold-up horses to sweep past in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Early Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Mehmar leads unopposed with others settling behind
scenarios.body: The pace becomes sustainable allowing the better prominent runners to stay competitive to the line. Alex Belardo and Comfort Line can quicken from their forward positions while some hold-up horses get caught too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stop-Start Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants the early lead and they crawl through halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole heavily favoring horses with tactical pace. The prominent runners get first run while the hold-up horses struggle for racing room in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Mehmar gets an uncontested lead and the field settles too far back
scenarios.body: The leader builds an insurmountable advantage as the field allows too much rope early. Despite his recent moderate form, Mehmar capitalizes on perfect positioning while others leave their runs too late.

races.paceDynamic: Timeless Charm and Expound will duel for the early lead, creating a genuine pace battle that should produce an honest gallop throughout. With only Echinacea and Baila Conmigo racing prominently, this sets up perfectly for the large contingent of hold-up horses to close from off the pace in the final three furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Timeless Charm and Expound burn each other out in a sustained early battle
scenarios.body: The pace duel weakens both leaders significantly, allowing the closing brigade to sweep past in the final furlong. Liberate and Yosemite Gold emerge strongest from the pack with their superior ratings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Timeless Charm gets first run on Expound and builds a decisive lead entering the straight
scenarios.body: The favorite kicks clear at the two-furlong pole and holds off the late challengers, with Expound weakening but the closers not quite getting there. Baila Conmigo runs on for place money.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Perfect Closer Setup
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong but both leaders maintain their effort to the straight
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop perfectly suits the hold-up horses who get ideal racing room in the final quarter-mile. Billie Frechette and Sir Callisto produce the strongest late kicks with their superior stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Echinacea or Baila Conmigo can get the perfect tracking position behind the pace battle
scenarios.body: One of the prominent racers avoids the early pace duel but stays close enough to strike when the leaders weaken. They get first run on the field while the back markers are still gathering momentum.
